title: File the annual unclaimed property holder report (Massachusetts)
description: Businesses holding property that has gone unclaimed — uncashed payroll or vendor checks, customer credits and refunds, unused gift cards, deposits — must report and turn it over to the state each year, after sending the owner a due diligence notice before the deadline. The annual report and payment are due November 1 for general property. A negative report is required even when the business holds nothing. Which state's law applies depends on the owner's last known address, or the business's state of incorporation when there is none, so a business can owe reports to several states.

title: Classify contractors with the ABC test before treating workers as independent (Massachusetts)
description: Massachusetts applies the three-prong ABC test, including that the work be outside the usual course of the business, to wage, hour and unemployment law. Failing any prong makes the worker an employee; the Attorney General enforces it, including penalties and criminal liability for willful violations.
